Summarize the following news article for an investor who follows Nvidia (NVDA).
Write a single paragraph of at most 100 words.

HEADLINE: Nvidia Acquires Workload Management System Developer SchedMD

BODY:
12:07 PM EST, 12/15/2025 (MT Newswires) -- Nvidia (NVDA) said Monday it has acquired SchedMD, the developer of Slurm, an open-source workload management system for high-performance computing and artificial intelligence.

Financial details of the transaction were not disclosed.

With the acquisition, Nvidia will continue to develop and distribute Slurm as open-source, vendor-neutral software, the company said.

Shares of the company were up 1.6% in recent Monday trading.

Price: 177.83, Change: +2.81, Percent Change: +1.61
text: Nvidia has acquired SchedMD, the company behind Slurm, a widely used open-source workload management system for high-performance computing and AI workloads. Terms of the deal were not disclosed, but Nvidia confirmed it will keep Slurm open-source and vendor-neutral, signaling a strategy to strengthen its software ecosystem around AI infrastructure without alienating other hardware partners. The move underscores Nvidia's continued expansion beyond chips into software and tooling that support large-scale AI deployment. Shares rose 1.6% to $177.83 on the news, reflecting modest investor approval of the acquisition as a strategic, low-risk addition to its ecosystem.
